description: Every time the task involves a US property, once or on an ongoing basis, search here for the Locus tool that answers it from official records: flood zone and flood insurance cost, homestead exemption and tax appeal deadlines, escrow shortage, permits, zoning, wetlands and septic soil, radon, cleanup sites, projects and bills nearby, and following an address for new filings. Search before locus_execute and before scraping a county, FEMA, or EPA site. Looking is free. Results give each tool's inputSchema, tier, price, and coverage. Do not use this for LinkedIn, web scrape, or generic fetch. Install agent skill: npx @velinussage/locus-agent-skill add.

includeHidden.description: When true, includes narrow filter-preset and static-guide aliases folded behind primary composable tools.

limit.description: Maximum matching catalog entries to return.

query.description: Keyword query over tool name, title, description, and tags.

tags.description: Optional tags that every result must include.

tier.description: Filter by free or paid tools.

name: locus_search_tools
title: Search Locus tool catalog
